items.title: Nvidia closes in on Hugging Face acquisition
items.summary: Nvidia has reportedly agreed to buy Hugging Face, the popular open-source AI hub, for $12.9 billion in a move that would let Nvidia both protect its chip empire and jump back into the cloud business.

items.title: Expanding OpenAI’s presence in Brazil
items.summary: OpenAI is expanding its presence in Brazil, deepening engagement with developers, businesses, and communities to support AI adoption across the country.

items.title: Viral AI startup Instinct has raised $350M at a $2.5B valuation
items.summary: The startup is only a year old but it has already generated a massive amount of hype (and money) while also spurring privacy concerns.
